note: City of Hendricks campground in the city park on Lake Hendricks, with a swimming beach, boat landing, fishing piers and a fish-cleaning house. The nine full-hookup sites are on a small loop right on the lakeshore; the trailside sites line the road on the north side, back from the lake. Four camping cabins open all year. --Claude
summary: City page read (browser; plain HTTP 406): 36 sites (9 lakeside full hookup, 27 electric/water), 2026 rates $35 trailside / $45 lakeside, phone reservations to the City Office, showers, dump, beach, boat landing; long-term rates on request. Lakefront holds for the lakeside loop only. Season dates not posted ('OPEN for the 2026 season').
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront, checked hard): keep lakefront WITH A CAVEAT naming the lakeside loop. On imagery the small loop at the west end of the park (centre about 44.5064,-96.4388) has its south row of pads (about 44.5063,-96.4393 to 44.5063,-96.4383, roughly six RVs) backing onto an open grass/gravel strip ~10-20 m from the water, with no road, trees or day use between (the loop road is on the pads' north side; a dock lies in front). The city calls these the '9 brand new full hook-up sites right by the lake'. The 27 trailside sites line the road along the north edge of the park beside the highway, ~150+ m from the shore behind a wooded block: not on the water. No site numbers could be placed (the city posts no site map).

Long-stay check (local, reviewer's call): the city advertises 'Long-term rates are available'; imagery shows the trailside row and the lakeside loop densely occupied. Nightly rates are posted and reservations are by phone, so occupancy could not be measured. Nothing on the page says sites are mostly seasonal.
Phone 507-275-3192 matches the page (City Office, reservations). Website OK but answers plain HTTP with 406 (Mod_Security); it loads in a browser.
Pin 44.50620,-96.43680 sits in the wooded block between the lakeside loop (~160 m W) and the trailside row (~100 m NE): inside the park, OK.
Season: 'The Hendricks Campground is OPEN for the 2026 season! Cabins are OPEN all year long!' - no dates, so season left unset.
Note cleaned: dropped the 27/9 site counts as standalone facts, dump, shower house and 'Reservable' (fields hold them); described where the lakeside sites are.
